difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a coherent module F on a locally Noetherian scheme X, the intersection Ass(F) cap U is finite for every quasi-compact open U (source lines 150-156). The proof reduces the statement to algebra in place: U is a finite union of affine opens, each is the spectrum of a Noetherian ring, F corresponds to a finite module over that ring, and the associated points of F are the associated primes of that module, so the finiteness follows from the algebra statement that a finite module over a Noetherian ring has finitely many associated primes.
